messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: High p99 spike for enterprise tenant MetronBank (tenant id T-9832) on dedicated pool metron-dedicated-eu3 — SLO breach (p99 > 5s). Auto-escalation threshold hit. Please join war room.
alice (oncall): I'm on it, joining. Any initial impact numbers?
carmen (sre): p95 ~1.1s, p99 currently ~6.2s for the pool, overall qps bumped ~40% since 14:08 UTC. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood/graphs/pool/metron-dedicated-eu3 (internal)
ben (infra): seeing increased tail on GPU utilization; some hosts hitting kernel-side OOM kills intermittently. Host list: host-43/host-58/host-59. Suspect noisy tenant or runaway batch sizes.
george (eng-runtime): logs show repeated KV cache misses for long context runs from T-9832. Their requests are 8k-12k tokens frequently — causing KV growth and long seq-latency. Also a few model variants hitting the slower non-optimized path.
dan (platform): proposing immediate mitigations: 1) soft-evict noisy tenant to fallback pool, 2) spin up warm spare in us-west-2 and route overflow, 3) apply per-tenant qps cap while we investigate.
elaine (acct): I've messaged MetronBank operations contact (metronops) letting them know we're investigating and that we'll send an update in 15m. They reported production impact (customer dashboards sluggish).
metronops (customer): Confirmed, internal alerts triggered. We can throttle some background jobs if needed. Please advise.
alice (oncall): OK, assign actions. Carmen/Ben, can you confirm isolation candidate? George, can you/give a quick command to route tenant?
carmen (sre): Isolation check: query shows T-9832 accounts for ~38% of pool qps and ~62% of p99 tail. Running per-tenant breakdown now.
ben (infra): quick check logs:
```
[2026-03-10T14:12:03Z] pool=metron-dedicated-eu3 qps=1200 p95=1.1s p99=2.8s
[2026-03-10T14:13:09Z] tenant=T-9832 qps=420 p95=1.4s p99=6.2s
[2026-03-10T14:14:01Z] host=host-59 oom_kill=1
```
ben (infra): host-59 had a process OOM during a long-context run. I'll mark it for recycle after we stabilize.
george (eng-runtime): To route the tenant to fallback pool (soft fallback) run:
```
rcli routing set --tenant T-9832 --route fallback:metron-dedicated-usw2 --mode=soft --drain=true
```
george (eng-runtime): That will keep existing sessions but send new sessions to usw2. Also can apply model fallback for T-9832 to quantized variant:
```
rcli tenant-config set T-9832 --model redwood-7b-q4f --max_seq_length=8192
```
dan (platform): I'm going to spin an extra 4 replicas in usw2 warm spare now.
```
rcli pools scale --pool metron-dedicated-usw2 --replicas=4 --type=gpu-a100
```
alice (oncall): Carmen/Ben, please start soft-routing and set a temporary qps cap while we bring up warm spare. Maria, prepare a customer-facing update draft.
carmen (sre): Applying per-tenant soft cap 200 qps for T-9832 now.
ben (infra): Marking host-59 out of service and draining. Eviction policy on T-9832 set to soft-evict after 60s of queueing.
maria (support): Draft update to MetronBank:
"We are experiencing an elevated p99 for your tenant due to a large volume of long-context requests. We have initiated traffic shaping and routing to reduce impact and will follow up with a technical report. ETA next update: 15 minutes. —Redwood Ops"
elaine (acct): sending that now. metronops, we've also queued a ticket with priority-1 and will set up a post-incident review.
metronops (customer): Got it, thank you. We'll pause non-essential ingestion jobs for the next 30m.
ben (infra): warm spare replicas starting, progress:
 - 1/4 ready
 - 2/4 ready
 - 3/4 ready
 - 4/4 ready
ben (infra): all replicas healthy. Routing rule applied. Please monitor p99.
carmen (sre): After soft-route + qps cap: pool metron-dedicated-eu3 p99 dropped from 6.2s -> 1.3s within 90s. Tenant tail now primarily handled in usw2 fallback pool.
george (eng-runtime): Also enabled model fallback for T-9832. Expect lower throughput per-request cost and better tail behavior.
alice (oncall): Great. Can we confirm no customer-facing errors or data loss? Maria/elaine?
maria (support): No 500s reported from MetronBank dashboards. Internal retries increased but within thresholds. Customer reports degraded latency only.
elaine (acct): MetronBank on call said latency improved after our notice. They want a quick RCA and timeline for a durable fix.
dan (platform): Next steps: schedule tenant-level quota in platform config to avoid runaway long-context runs, add an autoscale policy that reacts to per-tenant p99, and create an alert for KV cache growth per-tenant.
george (eng-runtime): I'll open a PR to add runtime guardrails: max_kv_entries_per_tenant and fallback-to-quantized after threshold. Will include telemetry tags for tracing.
alice (oncall): Handing off to night SRE Carmen for follow-up and postmortem. Carmen, confirm you have ownership.
carmen (sre): I have it. I'll run full postmortem and coordinate with eng-runtime and platform for mitigations. ETA: preliminary RCA in 48 hours.
alice (oncall): Thanks team. Final update to MetronBank noted, closing war room. :white_check_mark:
metronops (customer): Thanks, appreciate the quick action. We'll await the RCA and schedule a 1:1 next week.
